'''''The Story of Count Dooku''''', also known as '''''Dooku's Story''''' was a series of five [[Datacard/Legends|datadiscs]] that collectively detailed the life of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. The disks described his life from his beginnings as a young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and his rise to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masterhood]] to his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and his death at the hands of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

''The Story of Count Dooku'' was published on five data disks:
*Disk 1: ''Padawan''
*Disk 2: ''Jedi Master''
*Disk 3: ''Leaving the Order''
*Disk 4: ''Embracing the Dark Side''
*Disk 5: ''Dooku's Death''

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] obtained copies of all the disks.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Story of Count Dooku was the subject of a collection quest that was introduced the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' in [[2007]]. The disks were added as part of the [[:w:c:swg:Collection|Collection system]] with the [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7 update]] and were a random loot from creatures and NPCs found all over the galaxy.

Completing the collection of five data disks rewards the player with a plaque displaying [[Dooku's lightsaber/Legends|Dooku's lightsaber]], which can be used as decoration in the player's [[:w:c:swg:Housing|virtual home]].
